races.title: mallardjewellers.com Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WOLF RAYET showed improved form upped to the highest level on his final 2 outings last season, making the frame in the Anniversary Hurdle at Aintree, and he can take advantage of this drop into maiden company. Heading the list of dangers is Get Out Of My Way , who was only narrowly denied on hurdling debut, ahead of Old Habits . WOLF RAYET (IRE) GET OUT OF MY WAY (IRE) OLD HABITS (IRE)

races.title: WKD Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CRYSTAL ISLAND looked potentially smart when winning both starts over hurdles last season and Nicky Henderson's expensive point recruit can maintain his unbeaten record now chasing. Spectacularsunrise would've likely scored over C&D 3 weeks ago if not for a late fall so has to be respected, with Four Springs and The Gray Ghost completing the shortlist in a hot race. races.title: Weatherite Air Conditioning Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: On the back of an encouraging reappearance at Ascot 2 weeks ago, SHAKEYATAILFEATHER is perched just 1 lb above her last winning mark, gained at Kelso around this time last year and she looks primed to strike. Highlands Legacy won on last season's return to the track and represents a yard in excellent order so he's a definite threat, along with Authoceltic . races.title: Unibet Greatwood Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Unexposed LET IT RAIN and Harry Lowes head a remarkably strong hand for the Dan Skelton yard, with the former narrowly preferred off a mark that still looks lenient. The Hardest Geezer makes plenty of each-way appeal at the early prices, with last year's runner-up Helnwein set to be in the hunt for another in-frame finish. LET IT RAIN HARRY LOWES (IRE) THE HARDEST GEEZER (IRE)

races.title: Three Counties Christmas Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (Registered As The William Kidd) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Saint Clovis caused a bit of a surprise when taking this last year and representing the same connections, NEW GRANGE can repeat the feat with improvement on the cards. Cameron de Fiacre made a successful debut at Fontwell back in the spring and with his yard remaining in red-hot form, he's put forward as the main danger. Berkstar and Dundee Law are another couple fancied to be in the mix, too. NEW GRANGE (IRE) CAMERON DE FIACRE (FR) BERKSTAR (IRE)
